verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a code-defined backend that can be synced and deployed via its CLI, and app-level connections to third-party AI services using API keys. The evidence never explicitly names server-side functions, and it says nothing about payments or email integrations added from the builder. Missing for 10: explicit server-side/backend functions documentation, payment integration (e.g. Stripe), email-sending integration, evidence these are added from the visual builder, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add server-side functions and third-party integrations like payments and email from the builder

citations.quote: Connect your Base44 app to popular AI services like OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Mistral or any other AI platform that uses an API key.
Your entire backend is defined in code and configuration files
Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources
